corrected_value.title: Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect.

decisions.quote:
Each of the two experiments reported here sought to replicate
Bem’s (2011) two experiments on retroactive priming and to examine
the possible effects of the experimenters’ and participants’ beliefs about
psi on the outcome of the experiment in which they were participating.
decisions.reason: Both the shipped row and blind target 0 identify the same tested original paper: Bem, D. J. (2011), 'Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect,' Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 100(3), 407-425. The pairing flag ('conflicting_dois') arose only because the article's reference list (p. 84, lines 895-897) prints an erroneous physics DOI (10.1063/1.3663724), which the blind coder transcribed verbatim per codebook rules, whereas the shipped record holds the true APA DOI (10.1037/a0021524).

decisions.quote:
Overall, the two studies did not replicate the original Bem findings
for time-reverse priming on RT. Both failed to reach significance in the
preplanned confirmatory hypotheses.
decisions.reason: With the dependent target identity resolved to Bem (2011) (blind target 0), both the shipped coding and blind coding agree on 'failed'. Per Step 3 Rule 1 of the codebook, the authors' explicit overall verdict in the Discussion ('Overall, the two studies did not replicate the original Bem findings for time-reverse priming on RT') and Abstract ('In sum, the pre-registered confirmatory hypotheses were not supported') governs over exploratory English-only subgroup results in Experiment 1 and the new pro- vs. anti-psi prompt extension in Experiment 2.

Each of the two experiments reported here sought to replicate

decisions.reason: With the dependent target identity resolved to Bem (2011) (blind target 0), both shipped and blind codings agree on 'replication'. The paper reports two new multi-laboratory experiments collecting new reaction-time data from independent participant samples (N = 511 analyzed in Experiment 1; N = 586 analyzed in Experiment 2) to re-test Bem's (2011) published retroactive priming findings.
